overview: The committee discussed and approved an ordinance to regulate law enforcement identification and masking within the city. The measure aims to codify standard identification protocols and ensure officer accountability to build public trust.

items.title: Ordinance to Require Law Enforcement Identification and Limit Masking
items.summary: Approved a measure that prohibits law enforcement officers from wearing masks or disguises while on duty except in specific medical, tactical, religious, or weather-related circumstances. The ordinance also requires officers to display visible identification and establishes a protocol for verifying the identity of individuals claiming to be law enforcement during enforcement actions.
